description:
Standard Camera Observation Contract v1 (SafeRoute AI - System Specification 5.2 & SDD 7.1).
Produced by the Camera AI deployable and read by the SafeRoute Worker.

camera_id.description: Unique camera ID in SafeRoute registry (e.g. CAM_BINHTHANH_01)
camera_id.title: Camera Id

observed_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when frame was captured
observed_at.title: Observed At

source_updated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when observation was generated
source_updated_at.title: Source Updated At

source_revision.description: Monotonically increasing sequence revision for this camera
source_revision.title: Source Revision

water_depth_cm.description: Estimated water depth in centimeters (null if not calibrated or dry)
water_depth_cm.title: Water Depth Cm

depth_confidence.description: Credibility score for the estimated water depth
depth_confidence.title: Depth Confidence

safe_for_bikes.description: True if road conditions are passable for motorcycles and bicycles
safe_for_bikes.title: Safe For Bikes

road_water_ratio.description: Percentage of the calibrated road mask currently covered by water
road_water_ratio.title: Road Water Ratio

is_jammed.description: True if vehicle bottleneck / gridlock is confirmed
is_jammed.title: Is Jammed

total_vehicles.description: Total active vehicles detected on the road
total_vehicles.title: Total Vehicles

vehicle_breakdown.description: Classification breakdown (motorcycle, car, bus, truck, bicycle)
vehicle_breakdown.title: Vehicle Breakdown

slow_vehicles.description: Number of slow crawling vehicles (< 15 km/h)
slow_vehicles.title: Slow Vehicles

avg_speed_kmh.description: Average speed in km/h of moving traffic
avg_speed_kmh.title: Avg Speed Kmh

flow_vpm.description: Vehicles per minute crossing virtual tripwire
flow_vpm.title: Flow Vpm

road_mask_cached.description: True if pre-calibrated road mask was reused without re-segmentation overhead
road_mask_cached.title: Road Mask Cached

evidence_ref.description: URI or relative file path to the annotated evidence image
evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref

reason.description: Concise explanation of detection cues and gate decision
reason.title: Reason

title: CameraObservationEvent
